principles: Freshness is evaluated per source and per fact domain; a recent analytics article cannot refresh rules data.
Current official source claims must be rechecked after a known publication/update event.
Git-backed structured sources are tracked by commit SHA, not by a vague checked date alone.
Runtime projections are checked against their upstream structured source when a discrepancy appears.
Competitive analytics must carry a declared time window and rules/points patch identity.
Evidence from materially different patches is not pooled unless an explicit normalization/delta analysis justifies it.
Dependent analytics sources retain their upstream lineage; freshness of a derived dashboard does not make its underlying tournament sample newer.
Expert analysis freshness is publication-date scoped and cannot refresh empirical tournament data.
